title: Campaign Length and Milestone Timeline
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session
| stats min(_time) as start, max(_time) as latest, count as sessions, sum(duration_min) as minutes by campaign
| eval months=round((latest-start)/2629800,1), hours=round(minutes/60,0)
| sort - hours
description: Summarises how long each campaign has run in sessions, months, and total hours played.
value: Seeing a campaign's total investment is a satisfying record and helps set expectations for finishing the story.
implementation: Ingest session logs into `index=personal`; summarise length and total hours per campaign.
visualization: Table of campaigns by sessions, months, and total hours.
grandmaExplanation: It sums up how long each campaign has run in sessions and total hours, a record of the adventure.
